lines.speaker: ALICE
lines.text: I just sat down. The resumes are here.

lines.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
lines.text: Read each one carefully. Then use the second terminal. Look them up. People leave traces.

lines.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
lines.text: Their identity papers are in the tray. Aadhaar, PAN, passports. Compare everything.

lines.speaker: ADITYA (PHONE)
lines.text: Then you'll have found exactly what I hired you to find. Goodnight, Alice.
